hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: POSTGRES_USER
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: database裡面的super user docker container exec -it postgres_database psql -U super -d eventdb

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: POSTGRES_DB
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: A dummy variable. The database initialization is implemented in 01-create-databases.sql

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash -e #set -eux set -eu
LOCAL=Asia/Taipei # 要保留資料: -v ${CONTAINER_NAME}_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data # 把 init.sql mount 進 container -> PostgreSQL 啟動時自動執行 # DOCKER_COMMAND=" -e TZ=${LOCAL} --rm -dit -v ${CONTAINER_NAME}_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data -v ${HOST_SRC_PATH}/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql --name ${CONTAINER_NAME} -e POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER} -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} -e POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB} -p 5432:5432" DOCKER_COMMAND=" -e TZ=${LOCAL} --rm -dit -v ${CONTAINER_NAME}_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data -v ${HOST_SRC_PATH}/init_db:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d --name ${CONTAINER_NAME} -e POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER} -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} -e POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB} -p 5432:5432" docker container rm -f ${CONTAINER_NAME} 2>/dev/null || true if [ "${NEED_NETWORK}" = "true" ] then # docker network rm -f ${NETWORK_NAME} 2>/dev/null || true docker network rm -f ${NETWORK_NAME} || true docker network create ${NETWORK_NAME} DOCKER_COMMAND="${DOCKER_COMMAND} --network ${NETWORK_NAME}" fi if [ "${CLEANUP_DATABASE}" = "true" ] then docker volume rm -f ${CONTAINER_NAME}_data 2>/dev/null || true fi docker container run ${DOCKER_COMMAND} ${IMAGE_NAME}
